Author: Samit Gopal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text: ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:107431
Court No. - 71

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 18287 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Sumaila

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajneesh Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.
2. Heard Sri Vinod Raj Murti Yadav, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Rajneesh Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Raj Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Smt. Sumaila, with the prayer to direct the concerned court/Civil Judge (Junior Division) FTC Crime Against Women,
Moradabad to decide the Criminal Case No. 1658 of 2018, arising out of Case Crime No. 221 of 2017,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Moradabad in a specific period.
Smt. Sumaila vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46802956/
1 4.

entities.text: Sumaila vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the trial is of the year 2018.
The applicant is complainant of the case.

It is argued that delay in disposal of the said case is causing irreparable loss and hardship to the applicant and as such appropriate direction be issued for disposal of trial in time bound manner.
5.

Per contra, learned State counsel opposed the prayer made in the present matter by arguing that no such specific reasons have been made out for giving any direction for expediting the trial of the case and as such the application be dismissed.
6. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the trial is of the year 2018.
The same as per order sheet is going on.
There is no specific reason for expediting the same.

However, the applicant who is complainant of the case, may file an application for expediting the trial of the case before the court concerned within two weeks from today, which may as per its load of work, diary and pendency of cases, pass appropriate orders on the same within two weeks thereafter.
7. It is made clear that this Court has not passed any direction for expediting the trial.
8. The present application is disposed of.
